text: IFS is co-controlled by the private-equity firms EQT and Hg, with TA Associates remaining a minority shareholder; new minority shareholders include a wholly owned subsidiary of the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA) and CPP Investments.

source.name: IFS: IFS Attracts EUR 15 billion Valuation as Demand for Industrial AI Soars
source.quote: The valuation comes as Hg increases its stake to become a co-control shareholder alongside EQT, with TA Associates (“TA”) remaining as minority shareholder.

additionalSources.name: EQT, Hg, TA and IFS press release (Cision PDF): EQT, Hg and TA-owned IFS valued at EUR 15 billion in minority stake sale
additionalSources.quote: New minority shareholders also include a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (“ADIA”) and the Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (“CPP Investments”).
